messages:
alex: Quick weekly check-in for AcmeCorp onboarding — noticing a bump in error rate. 5xx up to 3.8% (+1.6ppt), timeouts 1.2% (+0.9ppt), 429s at 0.9% (+0.5ppt). Can we get top failing endpoints and a quick triage? :warning:
maria: Pushed a quick breakdown from logs — top 5 by volume: /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate, /v1/embeddings, /v1/batch/run, /metrics/ingest. 5xx mostly on /v1/chat/stream and /metrics/ingest. Sending sample log lines below.
```
# logs (truncated)
2026-01-18T14:02:11Z ERROR 502 gateway timeout "POST /v1/chat/stream" id=ch_abc123 lat=1203ms
2026-01-18T14:02:12Z ERROR 504 downstream timeout "POST /metrics/ingest" req=ing_77 lat=3001ms
2026-01-18T14:03:05Z WARN 429 rate_limited "POST /v1/generate" token_bucket=0.0
```
sam: Looking at deploy history — we rolled a runtime patch yesterday morning that changed KV cache behavior (retries=2 -> retries=0). Could explain more 5xx/timeouts under heavy prefix churn. Also saw a short spike in prefix miss rate around 13:55. :eyes:
jess: Heads-up — Acme is in week 5 of onboarding and renewal risk flag raised yesterday if latency stays high. We should get a short list of mitigation steps to share with CSM.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment redwood-runtime v2.14.7 started 2026-01-17T09:40Z; canary passed 30m later; promoted at 10:15Z. No rollback recorded.
maria: Quick repro curl for the /v1/chat/stream timeout so infra can reproduce locally:
```
curl -v -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/chat/stream -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"rw-chat-large","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"ping"}],"stream":true}'
```
sam: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) revert the retry change or set retries=1 for canary users, 2) temporarily increase concurrency on chat pool for Acme dedicated capacity, 3) enable prefix-KV warm caching for their onboarding data. Which one can we action fastest?
alex: Priority order: (2) Concurrency bump for Acme dedicated (ops), (3) Enable warm caching (eng-runtime), then (1) rollback only if other fixes fail. Jess — can you flag CSM comms that we're doing short-term scaling + cache warm?
jess: On it. I'll tell Acme we expect improvement within 30m after ops change, and we'll follow up with a post-mortem if rollback needed.
maria: Opening an internal incident ticket and adding logs + top endpoints. Ticket: INC-20260118-ACME-ERR. Assigning to @sam and @eng-runtime on-call.
sam: On-call acked, starting scaling now. I'll post results in 10min. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
(10min later) sam: Scaling done — Acme chat pool +20% capacity. Early telemetry shows 5xx on /v1/chat/stream dropped from ~2.4% -> 0.6% in the last 5m. Timeouts for /metrics/ingest still elevated, sending to infra to check downstream queueing.
alex: Great. Please keep monitoring. After /metrics/ingest is fixed, let's run a 1-hour holding period and then update the renewal risk status. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
